data.title: High-Value Item Not Received Claims Exceeding Threshold
data.description: Detects "item not received" (INR) claims filed on high-value orders that exceed a configurable dollar threshold. High-value INR claims are a primary vector for refund fraud, particularly when the delivery confirmation shows successful delivery. Repeated INR claims on expensive items from the same account or device fingerprint are strong indicators of first-party fraud or professional refunding services.

detection.condition: selection and filter_high_value and (filter_delivery_confirmed or filter_repeat)

falsepositives: Legitimate porch piracy where delivered package was stolen from doorstep
Carrier misdelivery to wrong address with GPS confirmation error
